description: 1000 new English customer requests to locate, open, or read their own wishlist. Authored structural patterns expanded over collection aliases and explicit saved-item/product or for-later recall questions. Generic saved-information questions require clarification and are excluded. Normalized duplicates with the existing wishlist corpus are excluded. Synthetic regression coverage; no independent holdout accuracy is claimed.
